correctness.rationale: The update is defined for every dimension \(d\ge2\) and field \(\mathbb F_{2^s}\). Ordering vertices by the first cube coordinate gives \(F=C\otimes I+I\otimes N\), where \(C^2+C+I=0\) and \(N^2=0\). Direct expansion yields \(F^2=C^2\otimes I\), \(F^3=I+C^2\otimes N\), \(F^6=I\), and \(F^2+I=C\otimes I\) invertible. The kernel of N is exactly {(v,(L+I)v)} and has half the base dimension. Consequently \(\operatorname{Fix}(F^3)\) has dimension \(2^{d-1}\) and \(\operatorname{Fix}(F^2)\) is zero; the period populations and orbit division follow. N has only size-two nilpotent blocks, each supplying a cyclic companion of \((t^2+t+1)^2\). The d=1 boundary is separately identified. Direct exhaustive testing over fields of sizes 2 and 4, plus distinct binary bit-matrix checks through d=8, passed from current source files; finite checks are not a replacement for the all-size proof.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the exact all-dimension codimension-one face-feedback dynamical law, not the classical linear finite-field method. The closest inspected public one-site cube record modifies a single diagonal entry, yielding nonreversible even-dimensional behavior; the one-bond record modifies two off-diagonal entries, yielding parity-dependent periods and transients. Neither stated theorem includes or implies the face-size diagonal perturbation, its universal invertibility, or its companion-block multiplicity. The early XOR paper supplies general methods for random directed networks, rather than this family-specific classification. Targeted searches found no explicit matching statement; unindexed sources and incomplete broad historical access remain residual priority risks.

value.rationale: A codimension-one cube face is an intrinsic geometric perturbation, not an arbitrary slice. Its simultaneous feedback replaces two opposite parity phases of the unmodified cube (two-step extinction and reversible involution) with the same fully reversible order-six network. The exact four-dimensional invariant modules and all primitive orbit populations across every dimension and every characteristic-two finite field give a complete natural family classification and clarify how spatially extended feedback changes global dynamics. This is more than a check of a few finite examples or a rephrased general matrix identity.
